class.name: HEGoStrataInput
class.brief_description: Sends Strata layers to HDA inputs as heightfield volumes.
class.description: HEGo finds this handler because it extends [HEGoInputHandler]; neither HEGo nor the terrain addon names the other. A layer is sent either cumulatively (the composed terrain through that layer) or raw (its own values plus separate binary ownership), with the channels and spacing set in the input's settings: terrain_mode, terrain_channels, terrain_spacing, terrain_channel_spacings, terrain_max_samples, terrain_compact_empty and terrain_bounds (a Rect2 in terrain-local metres: the lattice covers it instead of the terrain's bounds, as a tiled cook sends one tile at a time). A host with a terrain input cooks only on request, and strictly: an input that cannot be sent fails the cook.

method.name: sync
method.description: Takes a snapshot of [param node] and uploads it. The snapshot is recorded in the cook dictionary ([constant HEGoStrataOutput.COOK_KEY]), so the cook's terrain publication can tell whether this input changed while Houdini cooked.

method.name: requires_explicit_cook
method.description: Terrain stages are expensive and publish into layers, so they cook only on request.

method.name: requires_strict_cook
method.description: A terrain result is published all-or-nothing, so no input may be silently skipped.

constants.constant: Marks stored input settings as belonging to a terrain input, so its options and explicit cook rule stay in force while the source layer is missing.
